details.method: Keep parallel validation outputs and type-checker caches outside the frozen build workspace when conservative native-input detection includes unclassified ignored files. Snapshot source inputs before and after, and record a guard rejection separately from compiler or test success. This revision refreshes only the evidence binding after a referenced report byte-count correction; the proposed method and unexecuted paired trial remain unchanged.
details.when: Windows Godot native wrapper builds combined with concurrent validation or evidence preparation in the same checkout.
details.counterexample: Unchanged tracked source hashes alone do not prove unchanged build inputs: ignored nested output and cache files can participate. This does not justify excluding real generator inputs or relaxing the guard.
details.trial_plan: In a future isolated paired experiment, change one controlled ignored validation file during a build and require guard rejection; move equivalent validation output outside the checkout and require stable key and successful wrapper with identical source inputs. Record full key-input differences before considering this proposal verified.
